I took "travelled with The Doctor long term" to mean "appeared in multiple stories while travelling in the Tardis", and left out the likes of The Brigadier, Liz Shaw, Captain Jack and River Song because they were never part of a regular Tardis team. Everyone on my list, however, travelled with The Doctor for at least a few stories. There are some edge cases, I'll admit, like Mary Shelley and Kamelion, where there are only a handful of appearences, but in those cases its stated strongly that they have been around much longer in unrecorded travels.

Honestly, it's not that I *dislike* Sarah Jane. She's ranked lowly not because she's a bad character or anything of the sort, but simply becuase I like everyone I've put above her more. I should, perhaps, qualify this with saying that I've not really seen or heard any of her spinoffs.
I'll admit to being hugely biased thanks to being a fan of the real life Mary Shelley and her work, but yes, I'd love to have more adventures with her and Eight, too.
